perf_hint: Click a button label next to the mouse to assign it a function, a keyboard shortcut or a macro. Everything is saved to the active profile.
chroma_text:
%1 has no RGB lighting, so there is nothing to set here.
The green glow is only the look of the app. Support for RGB devices may come later.
reset_profile_text: Profile “%1” gets the factory settings of this mouse (%2) and all buttons back to their original functions.
stages_hint: Click a stage to use it. The button under the mouse cycles through them.
dpi_button_tip: The button under the mouse cycles the DPI stages (hardware).
act_key_desc: Click the field and press a key or a shortcut:
act_key_hint: While you hold the mouse button, the key is held too (ideal for games).
act_no_macros: You have no macros yet – create one in MACROS.
act_profile_desc: Each press switches to the next profile (%1).
macro_empty:
The macro is empty.
Use RECORD or INSERT.
record_hint: Press keys – steps and delays are added at the end.
create_macro_hint: Create a macro with the + button
profiles_hint: A profile holds the polling rate, DPI, DPI stages and button assignments. Click a profile to activate it – you can also switch from the tray icon.
remap_active_note: Remapping is active – the mouse runs through the OpenBlade virtual device.
set_close_tray: Closing the window = minimize to tray
set_close_tray_sub: The app keeps running in the background (needed for macros and remapping).
set_autostart_sub: The profile is applied right after the system starts.
set_hidden_sub: The window does not open, the app stays in the system tray only.
restore_desc: Resets the profiles (Default, Hra, Práca) to the mouse factory settings, all buttons to their original functions and the app settings to defaults. Custom profiles are deleted. Macros are kept.
restore_text: Profiles get the mouse factory values, custom profiles are deleted and the app settings are reset. Macros are kept.
t_device_failed: The change did not reach the mouse – is the OpenRazer daemon running?
t_unsupported: This device is not supported yet.
t_profile_exists: A profile with this name already exists.
t_last_profile: The last profile cannot be deleted.
t_default_rename: The Default profile cannot be renamed.
t_default_delete: The Default profile cannot be deleted.
t_profile_reset: Profile “%1” has been reset to defaults.
t_all_reset: Everything has been reset to defaults.
t_left_locked: The left button is locked so you never lose clicking.
t_macro_exists: A macro with this name already exists.
daemon_error: The OpenRazer daemon is not available: %1
r_not_found: The mouse was not found among the input devices.
r_grab_failed: Could not take over the mouse: %1
stages_custom_note: Custom sensitivity is on – click a stage to switch back to the stages.
custom_desc: Your own DPI value instead of the stages.
about_uses: Uses the OpenRazer driver and daemon
about_unofficial: Unofficial application – not affiliated with, endorsed by or a product of Razer Inc.
no_stages_note: This mouse has no onboard DPI stages – use the custom sensitivity below.
no_poll_note: The polling rate of this mouse cannot be changed.
stages_from_device: Stages read from the mouse (its factory values are not in the database yet).
b_subtitle: Builds OpenBlade-Synapse from source into a ready-to-run program.
b_install_toggle: Add OpenBlade-Synapse and the builder to the application menu
b_done: Done in %1 s. Start OpenBlade-Synapse from the application menu or with LAUNCH.
b_missing: Missing tools: %1. Run install-rust-deps.sh once (it asks for your password).
b_running_old: Done. OpenBlade-Synapse is still running the old version – press RESTART.
